description: Aiming items with an attack range: a spear (2 to 4.5, margin 0.125), a stick (2 to 6, creative 0 to 4, margin 0.5) and another (0 to 3, no margin). A still husk past the fist's reach (attacked with the stick); too near (picked as a fist would, the stick's attack refused); around the range's start; looked past within each margin, and with glass around it; hidden by blocks nearer and farther than the range's start; a block past the block reach; two husks in a row; sprinting up to one, backing off; the camera swept across it (the head's yaw is a tick late); a spear used in the main hand, and from the off hand with the main hand empty; a spectator; creative reaches; the player's own horse; turning in a boat; the world border, hit with a use (a block is placed against it) and an attack, and from outside; reset.

world.note: Fabric client gametest defaults: flat world, no structures, time and weather frozen, no mob spawning

build: item replace entity @a hotbar.0 with minecraft:wooden_spear
harness: Fabric client gametest: one client tick per frame, one server tick per client tick
